product_name_specific: K 1600 GT, K 1600 GTL, K 1600 BAGGER
risk_description: The rear strut link may have insufficient strength due to a part that does not meet the specifications and may deteriorate over time. This could affect rider handling and control, increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of two or three wheel vehicles and quadricycles.
